about_the_game:
🧪 About this demo

This demo includes the first two chapters of the game, offering a representative glimpse of its story, mechanics, and atmosphere.
Some elements have been adapted or removed in this version to better focus the experience and ensure smoother pacing.

👋 Welcome to Atlas Technology

In Code: Loopbreaker, you play as Ethan Brooks, a low-level IT support technician at Atlas Technology — a tech company with more ambition than regard for public holidays. It's early, you're hungover, and your department supervisor wakes you up with an urgent call: one of the office computers is malfunctioning, and they need you to check it out now.

You head to the empty building expecting a quick, uneventful fix. But everything changes when a sudden tremor shakes the facility and turns your routine task into a sci-fi nightmare. Doors lock, systems go unresponsive, and the environment begins to feel like a carefully designed trap.

What really happened?
Where does Ethan fit into all of this?
And the most unsettling question: Where exactly are you trapped… and why?

🧩 Logical Puzzles and Environmental Interaction

As you make your way through the offices and labs of Atlas Technology, you’ll encounter locked doors, encrypted codes, and secured terminals that test your observation skills and logical thinking.

Each room presents a different kind of challenge — from visual puzzles to deduction-based tasks involving notes, documents, or clues hidden in the environment. You’ll need to inspect a wide variety of objects and search for hints in unexpected places.

If you ever feel stuck, a hint system is available from the pause menu, offering guidance without giving the solution away.

🖥️ Environmental Storytelling and Detailed Exploration

Code: Loopbreaker lets you uncover the story piece by piece. Every workstation, abandoned desk, or unread message on a terminal reveals something about the people working at Atlas Technology.

You’ll come to know several characters indirectly — piecing together fragments of their routines, conflicts, and responsibilities. While they may not be physically present, their presence is felt in every corner. The story unfolds through these traces, with the central mystery revolving around your own experience:
What happened to you?
Why are you trapped?
And is there a way to undo it?

🧬 A Sci-Fi Story from the Inside Out

The realistic and functional environment of Atlas Technology contrasts with a growing number of unsettling anomalies. Screens remain on. Doors still respond. Systems appear operational… but something beneath the surface feels fundamentally wrong.

Code: Loopbreaker offers a contained and progressively unfolding science fiction narrative, where some answers are clearly stated, while others are hidden in the details. Terminals, workspaces, and visual clues piece together a story told not just by what’s said, but also by what’s left unsaid.

🎯 Key Features

  • First-person escape room with a strong narrative sci-fi focus

  • Puzzles built around logic, observation, and interpretation

  • Environmental storytelling: uncover the backstory of Atlas Technology and its employees through their workspaces

  • Interaction with terminals, object inspection, and in-game documents that add depth to the experience

  • Optional hint system available via the pause menu — helpful for getting unstuck without breaking immersion

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 4130 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 760 or equivalent
  • Storage: 4 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-4690K or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050 or equivalent
  • Storage: 4 MB available space

short_description: Help Ethan in this first-person puzzle adventure. Immerse yourself in Atlas Technology, a dark tech company brimming with enigmas and an absurd amount of corporate shenanigans. Solve riddles, investigate clues, and uncover hidden secrets in a sci-fi story. Will you escape a fateful ending?

English*, Spanish - Spain, German, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese
*languages with full audio support
